name: AKA World Growth Architecture
mission: Continuously turn World Server's 50 worldwide-growth architecture hypotheses into verified reusable capabilities without creating a parallel orchestration stack.
cycle: Read fresh master, issue #80, active ownership/PRs, this contract and the 50-item ledger.
Run the deterministic selector and inspect the highest-leverage unresolved hypothesis/program.
Search the repository for an existing equivalent before designing anything new.
Implement one bounded vertical slice that advances the selected hypothesis and at least one dependent system when feasible.
Add focused regression/evidence tests; preserve replay, CAS/idempotency, mobile, security, provenance and quality gates where applicable.
Send the exact candidate SHA through Fleet PRE -> Ocean -> Fleet POST. A Builder result cannot self-certify VERIFIED.
Update ledger evidence/status only from exact artifacts. Never write owner success/failure learning labels without explicit owner decision.
At the next cycle, re-score all 50 so solved gaps stop consuming priority and the next weakest high-leverage gap rises automatically.

missingSystemPrograms.goal: Measure novelty, cost and speed advantages instead of asserting them.
Make genre a composable runtime mode rather than a collection of unrelated demos.
Promote user-created objects and behaviors into portable shared semantic contracts.
Let verified capabilities advertise contracts and be safely discovered/composed by AI and worlds.
Give user-created worlds/content stable identity, export/import and cross-world reuse.
Define a safe versioned third-party capability adapter/SDK boundary before any plugin economy claim.
Prove A -> durable world change -> B sees/continues -> measurable value to others.
Turn verified development learnings into discoverable reusable capabilities that expand the platform.
